properties.statement: An AttoLang guest may resume only its exact committed local checkpoint within the current authenticated scope and generation.
An authenticated delta must chain from the current scoped checkpoint and advance it monotonically; global revision gaps caused by filtering are permitted.
A delta or cursor from a previous generation must be denied after an authorized snapshot rotation.
Guest booleans and decimal identifiers are not authentication or durability capabilities; a trusted adapter must establish both.
A mutation may retire only after verified scope, client, mutation ID, server-durable outcome, and durably persisted local retirement.
